title: Cozy Visuals
description: This isn’t just another visual pack that makes Minecraft unrecognizable. Every change has a purpose, not just looks. it keeps vanilla Minecraft intact while making it more immersive and satisfying to play!
body:
![cozy visuals](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d2440687bfa0819e54e12714f8e6b147d32c891.png)
---
> **Cozy Visuals** isn't just another visual modpack that turns Minecraft into something flashy, cartoony, or unrecognizable.
>
> Every feature is carefully chosen with a purpose, focusing on improving the atmosphere and overall feel of the game rather than adding effects just for the sake of it.
>
> The goal is to make vanilla Minecraft feel more immersive, polished, and satisfying to play while staying true to its original style.
>

## ⛏️ This pack adds:

> **Animation Overhaul**
>
> * Smoother, Springier animations for players, mobs, and even first-person interactions.
> * Countless small details, like swaying chains and lanterns, plus subtle interface animations when opening inventories and other menus.
>
> **Cozier visuals**
>
> * Shader-free block outlines, improved clouds, richer sky colors, bloom, and many other subtle visual enhancements.
>
> **Enhanced audio**
>
> * Wet footsteps during rain, satisfying inventory and hotbar sounds, plus ambient audio like birds, crickets, wind, and more.
>
> **Improved particles**
>
> * Better block-breaking particles, enhanced rain, desert sandstorms, and countless subtle effects throughout the game.
> * Includes particles for actions like stripping logs, flattening paths, running, punching certain mobs, and much more. Many effects also feature emissive lighting, glowing details, or bloom.
>
> **3D models**
>
> * A wide variety of items are fully 3D, including armor, food, books, trims, and more.
> * Some models also feature glowing details or enchanted-style outlines.
>
> **Refreshed main menu**
>
> * A brand-new panorama and title screen.
>
> ### ...and much more!
>

## 🗒️ Notes
> - This modpack has its own vibe. Shaders mess with the atmosphere, **so please play without**
> **them** for the intended experience.
>
> - I’m not an expert in optimization mods, but I’ve done my best to keep the pack running at a playable FPS.
> 
> - To make the game look just like it's supposed to, you'll have to set 'Particles' to 'All in video settings.
>
